decisions.reason: The plug-in line builds on the established offer, has a dedicated page that signals visible commitment, and carries sunk development across several models, so management will persist with it.

The building digital twin service fits the announced direction of geospatial IT integrated with enterprise systems, and any weak early results can be put down to a still-forming market, so management keeps investing.
The authentication and delegation service is close to the core offer and tied to the identity ecosystem the firm announced publicly, so dropping it would undercut earlier decisions.
The open GIS framework is a multi-model line with heavy sunk development that is central to the firm's open, extensible strategy, so commitment is high.
The identity service was publicly announced as new and enables seamless GeoIT integration, so this visible commitment and its strategic fit strongly favor keeping it.
